'''Karl Mott''' was the owner of the [[Skyhopper/Legends|skyhopper]] hangar in [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was the town's resident mechanic who worn grease-stained [[Jumpsuit/Legends|coveralls]]. Mott was a large hairy man who rarely spoke but when he did, it was worth listening to.
